realm.name: investigator
realm.description: Case investigator — Investigation Agent scope (Module 9 §5), local dev seed only. Catalogued in emg_policy_engine.roles.ROLE_CATALOG (FEAT-03-3).

realm.name: decision-maker
realm.description: Accountable decision-maker — Human Decision Workspace, local dev seed only. Catalogued in emg_policy_engine.roles.ROLE_CATALOG (FEAT-03-3).

realm.name: knowledge-steward
realm.description: Knowledge Graph steward — Knowledge Authoring UI, local dev seed only. Catalogued in emg_policy_engine.roles.ROLE_CATALOG (FEAT-03-3).

realm.name: service-account
realm.description: Service account role for internal EMG service authentication and controlled machine-to-machine access.

realm.name: svc-identity
realm.description: Sprint 3 (FEAT-02-3): least-privilege role for the Identity Service's own service principal. Catalogued in emg_policy_engine.roles.ROLE_CATALOG (FEAT-03-3).

realm.name: svc-authorization
realm.description: Authorization service role for managing policy evaluation and access control decisions across EMG services.

realm.name: svc-audit
realm.description: Sprint 3 (FEAT-02-3): least-privilege role for the (not-yet-implemented, EPIC-04) Audit Service's service principal — registered now for the same reason. Catalogued in emg_policy_engine.roles.ROLE_CATALOG (FEAT-03-3).

realm.name: svc-knowledge-graph-writer
realm.description: ADR-027 (Revision 2) Stage 0: least-privilege role for a service principal authorized to mutate the Knowledge Graph (e.g. a future ADR-020 ingestion service) — registered ahead of a concrete grantee, the same precedent svc-audit set. Catalogued in emg_policy_engine.roles.ROLE_CATALOG (FEAT-03-3).

clientScopes.name: emg-internal-services-audience
clientScopes.description: Sprint 3 (FEAT-02-3): adds the shared 'emg-internal-services' audience to a client-credentials access token, so services/identity's ServiceTokenValidator can enforce audience validation for machine-to-machine calls without per-caller configuration.

clientScopes.name: emg-human-classification-attributes
clientScopes.description: Group D Phase 1 Remediation (Blocking Fix 1, 2026-07-27): projects the classification_clearance and department user attributes (set below on dev.investigator/dev.decisionmaker) into the access token as top-level claims, so services/identity's login flow can read them from verified token claims. Prior to this fix, no protocol mapper emitted these user attributes into any token at all, so they were never actually reachable from the access token regardless of how the token was decoded.

clientScopes.name: emg-service-security-claims
clientScopes.description: SRS-2: emits verified tenant, classification-clearance, and realm-role claims consistently for every approved service client.

clients.name: EMG Identity Service
clients.description: Confidential client used by services/identity to exchange user credentials for tokens (FEAT-02-1). Not exposed to browsers.

clients.name: EMG Service Principal — Identity Service
clients.description: Sprint 3 FEAT-02-3: Identity service account client for M2M OAuth2 authentication.

clients.name: EMG Service Principal — Authorization Service
clients.description: Enterprise identity and access management configuration for EMG platform users, roles, and security policies.

clients.name: EMG Service Principal — Audit Service
clients.description: Sprint 3 (FEAT-02-3): representative development service identity for the future Audit Service (Module 6, EPIC-04). Registered now so service-to-service auth exists from day one; no Audit Service business logic is implemented in this sprint.

clients.name: EMG Service Principal — Knowledge Graph Writer
clients.description: SRS-2: approved least-privilege client for ADR-027 mutations.
